card.name: Spaces before ages and durations
card.fires_on: Mostly the blank space right before a number in antibiotic dosing text, such as an age after 'Pediatric Patients Aged' or a contact time after 'for'. Also a few spots inside antibiotic or organism names and after 'prevention' or 'treatment'.

modes.label: Space before age or time
modes.description: A space token that comes just before a number giving an age range or a duration.
modes.example: Dosage of AVYCAZ in Pediatric Patients Aged<< >>

modes.label: Inside anti-infective names
modes.description: Partway through a drug or organism name or a hyphenated resistance term.

modes.label: Linking word after treatment or prevention
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'treatment' or 'prevention' in infection indications.
